requiredFindings.title: JSON-escape supplied tree paths and entrypoints
requiredFindings.description: body() interpolates supplied paths directly into quoted JSON for directory entries (line 84), regular-file entries (line 90), and the entrypoint (lines 98-100). The manifest shape and path_ok admit quote characters and non-NUL controls. Adding the valid file lib/a"b.js to the default supplied files therefore emits a fragment containing "path":"lib/a"b.js", and parse_json(platform.as_bytes()).unwrap() panics. Quoted directory prefixes and a quoted first-file entrypoint fail at the other sites. Current controls use only FILES with simple ASCII paths, so the shared generator cannot construct role-valid fixtures for these lawful supplied trees.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Construct JSON string values through the existing JSON/canonical encoder, or correctly escape all interpolated path strings, including proper directory prefixes and the first-file entrypoint. Add supplied-tree controls containing quotes, non-NUL control escapes and non-ASCII names, asserting exact decoded paths, file lengths/digests, real body validation and signed-reader/candidate projection. Preserve existing p1 bytes and the default empty-components behavior; do not impose an ASCII-only path restriction.
